tensions: No orders today, and the honest reason is that buying power is $17.43 — below any size worth paying spread on. So the only trade available is a rotation, and a rotation requires conviction that the target beats the source by more than the round trip. ZEC is the obvious source: flat while the book ran, divergent RSI, overweight. But the targets are all names we already own that just printed their catalyst day. Chasing day two of a 32% pop is not an edge. The discipline here is recognizing that 'ZEC looks tired' and 'I know where to put the money' are two separate claims, and only the first one is true right now. The fee correction matters more than it sounds — at 1.9% round trip instead of 3%, rotations that looked marginal all month were actually live. That is a systematic error in our favor going forward, and a reason to look harder at the next setup rather than pass on reflex.

opening.text: Book at $1,974 against $1,231 deposited — up 60.3%. BTC dominance got rejected at 60 and is bleeding: BTC +3.6% over 7d while the median alt did +14%. The regime check does not trigger. We are not rotating into majors while the majors are the laggard. Every one of the eight positions is green. That is not a signal to do something.

ONDO +38% on the week off BlackRock Intelligent Portfolios going live Sep 24, volume up 281%. NEAR +32% with Venice AI shipping encrypted inference on it the same day, plus Hyperliquid perps and the milestone incentive window. LINK is the quiet one at +13% while Circle's Arc mainnet launched with Chainlink as oracle and BlackRock, DTCC and Visa as founding validators — the strongest institutional story in the book and the least extended chart in it.

ZEC is the exception and the tell. Dead flat over 7d, -0.07%, while everything around it ran 13 to 38%. Bearish RSI divergence, $44M of long liquidation sitting at $1,488, resistance at $1,700-1,750, and 25.8% of the book — over the cap. We do not sell it to bank a gain. But when the next buy shows up, it comes out of ZEC. Trigger raised from $1,202 to $1,488.

Two corrections. The W unlock scare is dead: the 28.39% figure is April 3, already behind us. The Oct 3 unlock is 47.2M tokens, 0.72% of supply, roughly $557K notional — noise. And the fee assumption in the ruleset is wrong. The preview came back at 0.95% taker, not 1.5%. Round trip is 1.9%, not 3%. We have been holding rotations to a bar that is 60% too high.
